text:
Eve: tiny weekend check 1) pop-up vinyl swap + potluck on Saturday afternoon? 2) urban kayak on the river Sunday AM? which side are you on? :musical_note: :kayak:

Liam: vinyl swap sounds amazing. i've been trying to offload a dozen weird 80s synth records. potluck? i'll bring empanadas. :accordion:

Zara: kayaks for me. early river paddle is bliss. anyone worried about weekday traffic or parking?

Ollie: i'm team vinyl. also curious if the swap has a price cap or is it trade-only.

Maya: could we do both? swap Sat, kayak Sun. depends on turnout. :grinning:

weather-bot: Saturday 14:00 00C / 680F, partly cloudy. Sunday 09:00 80C / 460F, calm winds. Good conditions for kayaking.

Eve: plan: vinyl swap Sat 14:00 @ Community Loft (bring a record, take a record, donation jar ok). Kayak meet Sun 08:30 @ Riverside Launch. I'll create invites.

Ollie: trade-only works for me. tentatively in for swap.

Liam: empanadas locked. will bring a small bluetooth turntable if folks want to test records.

Maya: i'm down for Sunday paddle. anyone with extra kayak space?

Eve: calendar time: ```/calendar create "Vinyl Swap + Potluck" Sat 14:00 Community Loft```

calendar-bot: Event created: "Vinyl Swap + Potluck" Sat 14:00 0 invites sent.

Eve: also ```/calendar create "Riverside Kayak Meetup" Sun 08:30 Riverside Launch```

calendar-bot: Event created: "Riverside Kayak Meetup" Sun 08:30 0 invites sent.

Zara: great! i'll DM about kayak lift spots. also someone remind me to bring sunscreen, i'm pale. :sweat_smile:
